statement: Native ARM64 Dolphin 2503 on merged W8 code enumerates and connects the MP+Nunchuk virtual Remote with caller EEPROM and imported synthetic MP/Nunchuk blocks, and reports mode 5. It then issues 12128 reads of A400F6/4 and receives 12128 error 7 replies before MP calibration. The mapping device is visible, but changing motion is not established. This names the unmodeled passthrough identity window; no additional model, codec, descriptor or API change is made, and no zero-gyro or physical incompatibility is inferred.

applicability.revision: Original virtual model; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Bounded virtual-host observation; mapping UI changes only where explicitly observed. No physical calibration, rate accuracy, audio, radio, game or whole-controller promotion.
